title: Video Project Quality Review Output
description: Matches the VideoProjectReview type in server/services/videoProjectQualityLoop.ts exactly — the section-07 adapter parses the skill output against this shape.

scorecard.description: Per-dimension sub-scores (0-10). Dimensions are defined in skill.md 'Review dimensions'. product_claim_compliance / product_fidelity are omitted entirely for a Motion Studio project (empty claimValidation).

dimension.description: Which scorecard dimension this issue belongs to (same key names as scorecard).

message.description: One concrete sentence naming exactly what is wrong and why, citing the scene id / cue / metric value.

repairStage.description: Optional QualityRepairStage this issue maps to.
